dialogues.speaker: Hermosa
dialogues.text: I'm afraid not. I'm good at photography, yes, but I prefer the title "adventurer."

dialogues.speaker: Hermosa
dialogues.text: I take my cat on various adventures and take many photos that tell a story.

dialogues.speaker: Hermosa
dialogues.text: I mean, who says pictures can't tell stories? Some of these get published in the newspapers, and some get used as illustrations for books.

dialogues.speaker: Hermosa
dialogues.text: Each one of my pictures will definitely contain my cat — makes them easy to identify, you know.
